description: REGRESSION for fdf0872a: user has DSN-level read+write on dsn-ts{{TSID}} but no table_perms grant on tblA{{TSID}}, and this request names the DSN explicitly and does NOT set ?abstract=true -- it goes through ReadRows, not ReadAbstractRows. Before the fix, ReadRows only ever consulted Authorized() when dsnName was empty (the legacy no-DSN-segment path); any request naming a DSN explicitly, like this one, skipped table_perms entirely and relied on the DSN-level check alone. Must be denied.
